inductive Mode where
  | unique
  | shared
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

-- Shared access is retained through every remaining projection.
def Mode.join : Mode → Mode → Mode
  | .unique, .unique => .unique
  | _, _ => .shared

structure Reference where
  reference ::
  mode : Mode
  object : ObjectId
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def Reference.owned (object : ObjectId) : Reference := ⟨.unique, object⟩

def Reference.shared (object : ObjectId) : Reference := ⟨.shared, object⟩

-- An empty slot is still allocated, but contributes no owner.
abbrev Slot := Option Reference

structure Object where
  className : ClassName
  fields : List (FieldName × Slot)
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure State where
  objects : List (ObjectId × Object)
  variables : List (VariableId × Slot)
  nextId : Nat
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def State.empty : State := ⟨[], [], 0⟩

inductive StoragePlace where
  | variable (name : VariableId)
  | field (object : ObjectId) (name : FieldName)
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def Stored (state : State) (place : StoragePlace) (slot : Slot) : Prop :=
  match place with
  | .variable name => (name, slot) ∈ state.variables
  | .field object name =>
      ∃ data, (object, data) ∈ state.objects ∧ (name, slot) ∈ data.fields

def References (state : State) : List ObjectId :=
  state.variables.filterMap (fun binding => binding.2.map Reference.object) ++
    state.objects.flatMap (fun entry => entry.2.fields.filterMap
      (fun field => field.2.map Reference.object))

def Allocated (state : State) (object : ObjectId) : Prop :=
  object ∈ state.objects.map Prod.fst

-- Liveness follows owners from a variable, then through initialized fields.
inductive Live (state : State) : ObjectId → Prop where
  | variable {name reference} :
      (name, some reference) ∈ state.variables → Live state reference.object
  | field {parent reference data name} :
      Live state parent → (parent, data) ∈ state.objects →
      (name, some reference) ∈ data.fields → Live state reference.object

structure Configuration where
  state : State
  code : List Statement
  deriving Repr

def Configuration.initial (program : Program) : Configuration :=
  ⟨State.empty, program.body⟩

def Configuration.finished (configuration : Configuration) : Prop :=
  configuration.code = []

end Dada.Shared

namespace Dada.Shared

-- Resolve records the effective permission of the whole path. A shared link
-- makes all subsequent access shared, even when a later stored link is unique.
inductive Resolve (state : State) : Place → StoragePlace → ObjectId → Mode → Prop where
  | variable {name reference} :
      (name, some reference) ∈ state.variables →
      Resolve state (.variable name) (.variable name) reference.object reference.mode
  | field {base source parent permission data name reference} :
      Resolve state base source parent permission →
      (parent, data) ∈ state.objects →
      (name, some reference) ∈ data.fields →
      Resolve state (.field base name) (.field parent name) reference.object
        (permission.join reference.mode)

-- Only a unique reference can be taken; copying leaves the source initialized.
inductive Take : State → StoragePlace → ObjectId → State → Prop where
  | variable (objects : List (ObjectId × Object)) (nextId : Nat)
      (leading suffix : List (VariableId × Slot)) (name : VariableId) (object : ObjectId) :
      Take ⟨objects, leading ++ (name, some (.owned object)) :: suffix, nextId⟩
        (.variable name) object
        ⟨objects, leading ++ (name, none) :: suffix, nextId⟩
  | field (variables : List (VariableId × Slot)) (nextId : Nat)
      (before after : List (ObjectId × Object)) (parent : ObjectId) (className : ClassName)
      (leading suffix : List (FieldName × Slot)) (name : FieldName) (object : ObjectId) :
      Take ⟨before ++ (parent, ⟨className, leading ++ (name, some (.owned object)) :: suffix⟩) :: after,
          variables, nextId⟩
        (.field parent name) object
        ⟨before ++ (parent, ⟨className, leading ++ (name, none) :: suffix⟩) :: after,
          variables, nextId⟩

-- A copy of a unique final field through shared access first promotes precisely
-- that stored owner to shared. This changes permissions, not object identity,
-- field names, or the represented field value.
inductive Promote : State → StoragePlace → ObjectId → State → Prop where
  | variable (objects : List (ObjectId × Object)) (nextId : Nat)
      (leading suffix : List (VariableId × Slot)) (name : VariableId) (object : ObjectId) :
      Promote ⟨objects, leading ++ (name, some (.owned object)) :: suffix, nextId⟩
        (.variable name) object
        ⟨objects, leading ++ (name, some (.shared object)) :: suffix, nextId⟩
  | field (variables : List (VariableId × Slot)) (nextId : Nat)
      (before after : List (ObjectId × Object)) (parent : ObjectId) (className : ClassName)
      (leading suffix : List (FieldName × Slot)) (name : FieldName) (object : ObjectId) :
      Promote ⟨before ++ (parent, ⟨className, leading ++ (name, some (.owned object)) :: suffix⟩) :: after,
          variables, nextId⟩
        (.field parent name) object
        ⟨before ++ (parent, ⟨className, leading ++ (name, some (.shared object)) :: suffix⟩) :: after,
          variables, nextId⟩

inductive Give : State → Place → Reference → State → Prop where
  | move {state cleared : State} {path : Place} {source : StoragePlace} {object : ObjectId} :
      Resolve state path source object .unique →
      Take state source object cleared →
      Give state path (.owned object) cleared
  | copy {state : State} {path : Place} {source : StoragePlace} {object : ObjectId} :
      Resolve state path source object .shared →
      Stored state source (some (.shared object)) →
      Give state path (.shared object) state
  | promote {state promoted : State} {path : Place} {source : StoragePlace} {object : ObjectId} :
      Resolve state path source object .shared →
      Promote state source object promoted →
      Give state path (.shared object) promoted

def State.bind (state : State) (name : VariableId) (reference : Reference) : State :=
  { state with variables := (name, some reference) :: state.variables }

def State.allocate (state : State) (className : ClassName) (fields : List FieldName)
    (references : List Reference) : State :=
  ⟨(⟨state.nextId⟩, ⟨className, fields.zip (references.map some)⟩) :: state.objects,
    state.variables, state.nextId + 1⟩

mutual
inductive Eval (classes : Classes) : State → Value → State → Reference → Prop where
  | give {state evaluated : State} {path : Place} {reference : Reference} :
      Give state path reference evaluated →
      Eval classes state (.give path) evaluated reference
  | giveShare {state evaluated : State} {path : Place} {reference : Reference} :
      Give state path reference evaluated →
      Eval classes state (.giveShare path) evaluated (.shared reference.object)
  | new {state evaluated : State} {className : ClassName} {declaration : Class}
      {arguments : List Value} {references : List Reference} :
      (className, declaration) ∈ classes →
      EvalArgs classes state arguments evaluated references →
      references.length = declaration.fields.length →
      ObjectId.mk evaluated.nextId ∉ evaluated.objects.map Prod.fst →
      Eval classes state (.new className arguments)
        (evaluated.allocate className declaration.fields references) (.owned ⟨evaluated.nextId⟩)

inductive EvalArgs (classes : Classes) : State → List Value → State → List Reference → Prop where
  | nil (state : State) : EvalArgs classes state [] state []
  | cons {before middle after : State} {argument : Value} {arguments : List Value}
      {reference : Reference} {references : List Reference} :
      Eval classes before argument middle reference →
      EvalArgs classes middle arguments after references →
      EvalArgs classes before (argument :: arguments) after (reference :: references)
end

inductive Step (classes : Classes) : Configuration → Configuration → Prop where
  | letValue {state evaluated : State} {destination : VariableId} {value : Value}
      {reference : Reference} {rest : List Statement} :
      destination ∉ evaluated.variables.map Prod.fst →
      Eval classes state value evaluated reference →
      Step classes ⟨state, ⟨destination, value⟩ :: rest⟩
        ⟨evaluated.bind destination reference, rest⟩

inductive Steps (classes : Classes) : Configuration → Configuration → Prop where
  | refl (configuration : Configuration) : Steps classes configuration configuration
  | step {before middle after} :
      Step classes before middle → Steps classes middle after → Steps classes before after

def Stuck (classes : Classes) (configuration : Configuration) : Prop :=
  ¬ configuration.finished ∧ ¬ ∃ after, Step classes configuration after

end Dada.Shared

theorem Take.updated (take : Take before place object after) :
    Updated before place none after := by
  cases take with
  | «variable» => exact .variable ..
  | field => exact .field ..

-- Taking a reference never changes an object's class or field domain. Every
-- owner remaining in a field was already present in that same field.
theorem Take.object_data {before after : State} {place : StoragePlace} {object : ObjectId}
    (taken : Take before place object after) (id : ObjectId) (data : Object)
    (stored : (id, data) ∈ after.objects) :
    ∃ oldData, (id, oldData) ∈ before.objects ∧
      data.className = oldData.className ∧
      data.fields.map Prod.fst = oldData.fields.map Prod.fst ∧
      ∀ name target, (name, some target) ∈ data.fields →
        (name, some target) ∈ oldData.fields := by
  cases taken with
  | «variable» objects nextId leading suffix name object =>
    exact ⟨data, stored, rfl, rfl, fun _ _ member => member⟩
  | field variables nextId leadingObjects trailingObjects parent className
      leadingFields trailingFields fieldName object =>
    simp only [List.mem_append, List.mem_cons] at stored
    rcases stored with unchanged | changed | unchanged
    · exact ⟨data, List.mem_append_left _ unchanged, rfl, rfl, fun _ _ member => member⟩
    · cases changed
      refine ⟨⟨className, leadingFields ++ (fieldName, some object) :: trailingFields⟩,
        ?_, rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simp
      · simp
      · intro name target member
        simp only [List.mem_append, List.mem_cons] at member ⊢
        rcases member with member | impossible | member
        · exact Or.inl member
        · have : some target = none := congrArg Prod.snd impossible
          contradiction
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inr member)
    · exact ⟨data, List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ unchanged),
        rfl, rfl, fun _ _ member => member⟩

-- The first argument receives identity 0, the second identity 1, and only then
-- is their containing Pair allocated as identity 2.
private def orderedPairState : State :=
  ⟨[(2, ⟨"Pair", [("left", some 0), ("right", some 1)]⟩),
    (1, ⟨"Token", []⟩), (0, ⟨"Token", []⟩)], [("p", some 2)], 3⟩

example : Step pairClasses
    ⟨State.empty, [⟨"p", .new "Pair" [.new "Token" [], .new "Token" []]⟩]⟩
    ⟨orderedPairState, []⟩ := by
  let first := State.empty.allocate "Token" [] []
  let second := first.allocate "Token" [] []
  apply Step.letValue (object := 2)
    (evaluated := second.allocate "Pair" ["left", "right"] [0, 1])
  · simp [second, first, State.allocate, State.empty]
  · apply Eval.new (declaration := ⟨["left", "right"]⟩)
      (evaluated := second) (objects := [0, 1])
    · simp [pairClasses]
    · apply EvalArgs.cons (middle := first) (object := 0)
      · exact Eval.new (by simp [pairClasses]) (.nil _) rfl (by simp [State.empty])
      · apply EvalArgs.cons (middle := second) (object := 1)
        · exact Eval.new (by simp [pairClasses]) (.nil _) rfl (by decide)
        · exact EvalArgs.nil _
    · rfl
    · decide

private def repeatedGive : Value :=
  .new "Pair" [.give (.variable "t"), .give (.variable "t")]

-- The first give empties t; the second argument has no reference left to take.
private theorem repeated_give_no_eval : ¬ Eval pairClasses tokenState repeatedGive after object := by
  intro evaluated
  cases evaluated with
  | new _ arguments _ _ =>
    cases arguments with
    | cons first rest =>
      cases first with
      | give _ taken =>
        have length := taken.references.length_eq
        have empty : References _ = [] := List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero (by
          simpa [References, tokenState] using length.symm)
        cases rest with
        | cons second _ =>
          cases second with
          | give resolved _ =>
            cases resolved with
            | «variable» stored =>
              have member : _ ∈ References _ := List.mem_append_left _
                (List.mem_filterMap.mpr ⟨(_, _), stored, rfl⟩)
              rw [empty] at member
              exact List.not_mem_nil member

private def repeatedGiveConfiguration : Configuration :=
  ⟨tokenState, [⟨"p", repeatedGive⟩]⟩

private theorem repeated_give_stuck : Stuck pairClasses repeatedGiveConfiguration := by
  constructor
  · simp [repeatedGiveConfiguration, Configuration.finished]
  · rintro ⟨after, step⟩
    cases step with
    | letValue _ evaluation => exact repeated_give_no_eval evaluation

example : Stuck pairClasses repeatedGiveConfiguration ∧
    ¬ ∃ after, Steps pairClasses repeatedGiveConfiguration after ∧ after.finished := by
  refine ⟨repeated_give_stuck, ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨after, execution, finished⟩
  cases execution with
  | refl => exact repeated_give_stuck.1 finished
  | step first _ => exact repeated_give_stuck.2 ⟨_, first⟩

private theorem createToken (rest : List Statement) :

private theorem createBox (rest : List Statement) :
    Step exampleClasses ⟨tokenState, boxProgram ++ rest⟩ ⟨boxState, rest⟩ := by
  let cleared : State := ⟨tokenState.objects, [("t", none)], 1⟩

namespace Dada.Unique

private def VariableRoot (state : State) (object : ObjectId) : Prop :=
  ∃ name, (name, some object) ∈ state.variables

private def FieldEdge (state : State) (parent object : ObjectId) : Prop :=
  ∃ data name, (parent, data) ∈ state.objects ∧ (name, some object) ∈ data.fields

private theorem reference_origin {state : State} {object : ObjectId}
    (member : object ∈ References state) :
    VariableRoot state object ∨ ∃ parent, Allocated state parent ∧ FieldEdge state parent object := by
  simp only [References, List.mem_append, List.mem_filterMap, List.mem_flatMap] at member
  rcases member with root | field
  · obtain ⟨⟨name, slot⟩, stored, value⟩ := root
    dsimp at value
    subst slot
    exact Or.inl ⟨name, stored⟩
  · obtain ⟨⟨parent, data⟩, allocated, ⟨⟨name, slot⟩, stored, value⟩⟩ := field
    dsimp at value
    subst slot
    exact Or.inr ⟨parent, List.mem_map.mpr ⟨(parent, data), allocated, rfl⟩,
      data, name, allocated, stored⟩

-- The finite allocation order prevents an owner-only cycle from satisfying
-- coverage without any variable root.
theorem WellFormed.allocated_live (wf : WellFormed classes state)
    (allocated : Allocated state object) : Live state object := by
  have rooted : Dada.Common.Rooted (VariableRoot state) (FieldEdge state) object :=
    Dada.Common.rooted_of_covered ObjectId.index state.nextId
      (fun node member => by
        obtain ⟨⟨_, data⟩, stored, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp member
        exact wf.bounds _ data stored)
      (fun node member => reference_origin ((wf.referencesComplete node).mpr member))
      (fun parent node _ edge => by
        obtain ⟨data, name, stored, field⟩ := edge
        exact wf.older parent data name node stored field)
      object allocated
  clear allocated
  induction rooted with
  | root atRoot =>
    obtain ⟨name, stored⟩ := atRoot
    exact .variable stored
  | field _ edge ih =>
    obtain ⟨data, name, stored, field⟩ := edge
    exact .field ih stored field

theorem WellFormed.live_allocated (wf : WellFormed classes state)
    (live : Live state object) : Allocated state object := by
  apply (wf.referencesComplete object).mp
  cases live with
  | «variable» stored =>
    exact List.mem_append_left _ (List.mem_filterMap.mpr ⟨(_, some object), stored, rfl⟩)
  | field _ stored field =>
    exact List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_flatMap.mpr
      ⟨(_, _), stored, List.mem_filterMap.mpr ⟨(_, some object), field, rfl⟩⟩)

-- Liveness is a graph property, independent of the transition relation.
theorem WellFormed.live_iff_allocated (wf : WellFormed classes state) :
    Live state object ↔ Allocated state object :=
  ⟨wf.live_allocated, wf.allocated_live⟩

-- There is exactly one owning occurrence of each allocated object, counted
-- across both variables and object fields.
theorem WellFormed.owner_count (wf : WellFormed classes state)
    (allocated : Allocated state object) : (References state).count object = 1 := by
  exact wf.referencesUnique.count_of_mem ((wf.referencesComplete object).mpr allocated)

end Dada.Unique

import Unique.Effects

namespace Dada.Unique

-- Class layouts are fixed, and every field name identifies one slot.
def ClassesWellFormed (classes : Classes) : Prop :=
  (classes.map Prod.fst).Nodup ∧
    ∀ name declaration, (name, declaration) ∈ classes → declaration.fields.Nodup

-- These conditions describe arbitrary finite graphs independently of execution.
-- The older-target condition is maintained because constructors only capture
-- previously allocated objects; it rules out owning cycles in this language.
structure WellFormed (classes : Classes) (state : State) : Prop where
  objectKeys : (state.objects.map Prod.fst).Nodup
  variableKeys : (state.variables.map Prod.fst).Nodup
  shapes : ∀ id data, (id, data) ∈ state.objects →
    ∃ declaration, (data.className, declaration) ∈ classes ∧
      data.fields.map Prod.fst = declaration.fields ∧ declaration.fields.Nodup
  bounds : ∀ id data, (id, data) ∈ state.objects → id.index < state.nextId
  older : ∀ id data name target, (id, data) ∈ state.objects →
    (name, some target) ∈ data.fields → target.index < id.index
  referencesUnique : (References state).Nodup
  referencesComplete : ∀ id, id ∈ References state ↔ Allocated state id

-- Expression results are temporary owning roots until the surrounding constructor
-- or statement stores them. The empty-root case is the statement invariant.
structure WellFormedWith (classes : Classes) (state : State) (pending : List ObjectId) : Prop where
  objectKeys : (state.objects.map Prod.fst).Nodup
  variableKeys : (state.variables.map Prod.fst).Nodup
  shapes : ∀ id data, (id, data) ∈ state.objects →
    ∃ declaration, (data.className, declaration) ∈ classes ∧
      data.fields.map Prod.fst = declaration.fields ∧ declaration.fields.Nodup
  bounds : ∀ id data, (id, data) ∈ state.objects → id.index < state.nextId
  older : ∀ id data name target, (id, data) ∈ state.objects →
    (name, some target) ∈ data.fields → target.index < id.index
  referencesUnique : (pending ++ References state).Nodup
  referencesComplete : ∀ id, id ∈ pending ++ References state ↔ Allocated state id

private abbrev slotReferences {K : Type} (slots : List (K × Slot)) : List ObjectId :=
  slots.filterMap (fun entry => entry.2)

-- Taking an owner changes neither object allocation nor slot identities.
theorem Take.object_keys (take : Take before place object after) :
    after.objects.map Prod.fst = before.objects.map Prod.fst := by
  cases take <;> simp

theorem Take.variable_keys (take : Take before place object after) :
    after.variables.map Prod.fst = before.variables.map Prod.fst := by
  cases take <;> simp

theorem Take.next_id (take : Take before place object after) :
    after.nextId = before.nextId := by
  cases take <;> rfl

-- One occurrence leaves the source graph and becomes the expression's result.
theorem Take.references (take : Take before place object after) :
    (References before).Perm (object :: References after) := by
  cases take with
  | «variable» objects next leading suffix name object =>
    simp only [References, List.filterMap_append, List.filterMap_cons]
    simpa only [List.append_assoc, List.cons_append] using
      (List.perm_middle (a := object)
        (l₁ := leading.filterMap (fun binding => binding.2))
        (l₂ := suffix.filterMap (fun binding => binding.2) ++
          objects.flatMap (fun entry => entry.2.fields.filterMap (fun field => field.2))))
  | field variables next before after parent className leading suffix name object =>
    simp only [References, List.flatMap_append, List.flatMap_cons, List.filterMap_append,
      List.filterMap_cons]
    simpa only [List.append_assoc, List.cons_append] using
      (List.perm_middle (a := object)
        (l₁ := variables.filterMap (fun binding => binding.2) ++
          before.flatMap (fun entry => entry.2.fields.filterMap (fun field => field.2)) ++
          leading.filterMap (fun field => field.2))
        (l₂ := suffix.filterMap (fun field => field.2) ++
          after.flatMap (fun entry => entry.2.fields.filterMap (fun field => field.2))))

private theorem zipped_field_names (fields : List FieldName) (objects : List ObjectId)
    (lengths : objects.length = fields.length) :
    (fields.zip (objects.map some)).map Prod.fst = fields := by
  apply List.map_fst_zip
  simp [lengths]

private theorem zipped_field_references (fields : List FieldName) (objects : List ObjectId)
    (lengths : objects.length = fields.length) :
    slotReferences (fields.zip (objects.map some)) = objects := by
  have seconds := List.map_snd_zip (l₁ := fields) (l₂ := objects.map some)
    (by simp [lengths])
  have filtered := congrArg (List.filterMap id) seconds
  simpa [List.filterMap_map, Function.comp_def, slotReferences] using filtered


theorem WellFormed.empty (classes : Classes) : WellFormed classes State.empty := by
  constructor <;> simp [State.empty, References, Allocated]

theorem WellFormed.with_empty (wf : WellFormed classes state) :
    WellFormedWith classes state [] := by
  exact ⟨wf.objectKeys, wf.variableKeys, wf.shapes, wf.bounds, wf.older,
    by simpa using wf.referencesUnique, by simpa using wf.referencesComplete⟩

theorem WellFormedWith.without_pending (wf : WellFormedWith classes state []) :
    WellFormed classes state := by
  exact ⟨wf.objectKeys, wf.variableKeys, wf.shapes, wf.bounds, wf.older,
    by simpa using wf.referencesUnique, by simpa using wf.referencesComplete⟩

theorem WellFormedWith.perm (wf : WellFormedWith classes state pending)
    (permutation : pending.Perm other) : WellFormedWith classes state other := by
  have refs := permutation.append_right (References state)
  exact ⟨wf.objectKeys, wf.variableKeys, wf.shapes, wf.bounds, wf.older,
    refs.nodup_iff.mp wf.referencesUnique,
    fun id => refs.mem_iff.symm.trans (wf.referencesComplete id)⟩

theorem Take.preserves_pending (wf : WellFormedWith classes before pending)
    (take : Take before place object after) :
    WellFormedWith classes after (object :: pending) := by
  have references : (pending ++ References before).Perm
      ((object :: pending) ++ References after) :=
    (take.references.append_left pending).trans List.perm_middle
  constructor
  · simpa [take.object_keys] using wf.objectKeys
  · simpa [take.variable_keys] using wf.variableKeys
  · intro id data member
    obtain ⟨oldData, oldMember, sameClass, sameFields, _⟩ := take.object_data id data member
    obtain ⟨declaration, declared, fields, distinct⟩ := wf.shapes id oldData oldMember
    exact ⟨declaration, sameClass ▸ declared, sameFields.trans fields, distinct⟩
  · intro id data member
    obtain ⟨oldData, oldMember, _, _, _⟩ := take.object_data id data member
    simpa [take.next_id] using wf.bounds id oldData oldMember
  · intro id data name target member field
    obtain ⟨oldData, oldMember, _, _, remaining⟩ := take.object_data id data member
    exact wf.older id oldData name target oldMember (remaining name target field)
  · exact references.nodup_iff.mp wf.referencesUnique
  · intro id
    simpa [Allocated, take.object_keys] using
      references.mem_iff.symm.trans (wf.referencesComplete id)

theorem WellFormedWith.bind (wf : WellFormedWith classes state [object])
    (fresh : destination ∉ state.variables.map Prod.fst) :
    WellFormed classes (state.bind destination object) := by
  constructor
  · exact wf.objectKeys
  · simpa [State.bind] using List.nodup_cons.mpr ⟨fresh, wf.variableKeys⟩
  · exact wf.shapes
  · exact wf.bounds
  · exact wf.older
  · simpa [State.bind, References] using wf.referencesUnique
  · simpa [State.bind, References, Allocated] using wf.referencesComplete

theorem Take.bind_preserves (wf : WellFormed classes before)
    (take : Take before place object after)
    (fresh : destination ∉ before.variables.map Prod.fst) :
    WellFormed classes (after.bind destination object) := by
  apply (take.preserves_pending wf.with_empty).bind
  simpa [take.variable_keys] using fresh

private theorem pending_bound (wf : WellFormedWith classes state pending)
    (member : object ∈ pending) : object.index < state.nextId := by
  have referred : object ∈ pending ++ References state := List.mem_append_left _ member
  obtain ⟨⟨id, data⟩, allocated, equality⟩ :=
    List.mem_map.mp ((wf.referencesComplete object).mp referred)
  simp only at equality
  subst id
  exact wf.bounds object data allocated

private theorem allocation_references (state : State)
    (lengths : objects.length = fields.length) :
    References (state.allocate className fields objects) =
      slotReferences state.variables ++ objects ++
        state.objects.flatMap (fun entry => slotReferences entry.2.fields) := by
  simp [State.allocate, References, slotReferences, List.append_assoc,
    zipped_field_references fields objects lengths]

theorem WellFormedWith.allocate (classesWf : ClassesWellFormed classes)
    (wf : WellFormedWith classes state (objects ++ pending))
    (declared : (className, declaration) ∈ classes)
    (lengths : objects.length = declaration.fields.length) :
    WellFormedWith classes (state.allocate className declaration.fields objects)
      (ObjectId.mk state.nextId :: pending) := by
  have freshObject : ObjectId.mk state.nextId ∉ state.objects.map Prod.fst := by
    intro member
    obtain ⟨⟨id, data⟩, allocated, same⟩ := List.mem_map.mp member
    simp only at same
    subst id
    exact Nat.lt_irrefl _ (wf.bounds _ _ allocated)
  have freshReference : ObjectId.mk state.nextId ∉ (objects ++ pending) ++ References state := by
    intro member
    exact freshObject ((wf.referencesComplete _).mp member)
  have references : (ObjectId.mk state.nextId :: ((objects ++ pending) ++ References state)).Perm
      ((ObjectId.mk state.nextId :: pending) ++
        References (state.allocate className declaration.fields objects)) := by
    apply List.Perm.cons
    rw [allocation_references state lengths]
    apply List.perm_iff_count.mpr
    intro id
    simp only [List.append_eq, References, slotReferences, List.count_append]
    omega
  constructor
  · simpa [State.allocate] using List.nodup_cons.mpr ⟨freshObject, wf.objectKeys⟩
  · exact wf.variableKeys
  · intro id data member
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with same | old
    · cases same
      exact ⟨declaration, declared, zipped_field_names _ _ lengths,
        classesWf.2 _ _ declared⟩
    · exact wf.shapes id data old
  · intro id data member
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with same | old
    · cases same
      exact Nat.lt_succ_self _
    · exact Nat.lt_succ_of_lt (wf.bounds id data old)
  · intro id data name target member field
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with same | old
    · cases same
      have referred : target ∈ slotReferences (declaration.fields.zip (objects.map some)) :=
        List.mem_filterMap.mpr ⟨(name, some target), field, rfl⟩
      rw [zipped_field_references _ _ lengths] at referred
      exact pending_bound wf (List.mem_append_left _ referred)
    · exact wf.older id data name target old field
  · exact references.nodup_iff.mp (List.nodup_cons.mpr ⟨freshReference, wf.referencesUnique⟩)
  · intro id
    rw [← references.mem_iff]
    simp only [List.mem_cons, wf.referencesComplete, Allocated, State.allocate, List.map_cons]

theorem Eval.preserves_pending (classesWf : ClassesWellFormed classes)
    (evaluation : Eval classes before value after object) :
    ∀ pending, WellFormedWith classes before pending →
      WellFormedWith classes after (object :: pending) := by
  induction evaluation using Eval.rec
    (motive_2 := fun before _ after objects _ => ∀ pending,
      WellFormedWith classes before pending →
        WellFormedWith classes after (objects ++ pending)) with
  | give _ take => exact fun _ wf => take.preserves_pending wf
  | new declared _ lengths _ ih =>
    exact fun pending wf => (ih pending wf).allocate classesWf declared lengths
  | nil => assumption
  | cons _ _ first rest =>
    rename_i pending wf
    have result := rest _ (first pending wf)
    exact result.perm List.perm_middle

theorem Eval.variable_keys (evaluation : Eval classes before value after object) :
    after.variables.map Prod.fst = before.variables.map Prod.fst := by
  induction evaluation using Eval.rec
    (motive_2 := fun before _ after _ _ =>
      after.variables.map Prod.fst = before.variables.map Prod.fst) with
  | give _ take => exact take.variable_keys
  | new _ _ _ _ ih => exact ih
  | nil => rfl
  | cons _ _ first rest => exact rest.trans first

theorem EvalArgs.length (evaluation : EvalArgs classes before arguments after objects) :
    objects.length = arguments.length := by
  induction evaluation using EvalArgs.rec
    (motive_1 := fun _ _ _ _ _ => True) with
  | give => trivial
  | new => trivial
  | nil => rfl
  | cons _ _ _ rest => simpa using rest

theorem Step.preserves_wellFormed (classesWf : ClassesWellFormed classes)
    (wf : WellFormed classes before.state) (step : Step classes before after) :
    WellFormed classes after.state := by
  cases step with
  | letValue fresh evaluation =>
    exact (evaluation.preserves_pending classesWf [] wf.with_empty).bind fresh

theorem Steps.preserves_wellFormed (classesWf : ClassesWellFormed classes)
    (wf : WellFormed classes before.state) (steps : Steps classes before after) :
    WellFormed classes after.state := by
  induction steps with
  | refl => exact wf
  | step first _ ih => exact ih (first.preserves_wellFormed classesWf wf)

theorem Steps.from_initial (classesWf : ClassesWellFormed program.classes)
    (steps : Steps program.classes (Configuration.initial program) after) :
    WellFormed program.classes after.state :=
  steps.preserves_wellFormed classesWf (WellFormed.empty _)

import Unique.Syntax

namespace Dada.Unique

-- A slot is allocated even when it no longer contains an owner.
abbrev Slot := Option ObjectId

structure Object where
  className : ClassName
  fields : List (FieldName × Slot)
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure State where
  objects : List (ObjectId × Object)
  variables : List (VariableId × Slot)
  nextId : Nat
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def State.empty : State := ⟨[], [], 0⟩

inductive StoragePlace where
  | variable (name : VariableId)
  | field (object : ObjectId) (name : FieldName)
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def Stored (state : State) (place : StoragePlace) (slot : Slot) : Prop :=
  match place with
  | .variable name => (name, slot) ∈ state.variables
  | .field object name =>
      ∃ data, (object, data) ∈ state.objects ∧ (name, slot) ∈ data.fields

-- Updating a place replaces an existing slot; it neither creates a variable
-- nor adds an object's field. Empty slots remain present.
inductive Updated : State → StoragePlace → Slot → State → Prop where
  | variable (objects : List (ObjectId × Object)) (nextId : Nat)
      (leading suffix : List (VariableId × Slot)) (name : VariableId) (old new : Slot) :
      Updated ⟨objects, leading ++ (name, old) :: suffix, nextId⟩ (.variable name) new
        ⟨objects, leading ++ (name, new) :: suffix, nextId⟩
  | field (variables : List (VariableId × Slot)) (nextId : Nat)
      (before after : List (ObjectId × Object)) (parent : ObjectId) (className : ClassName)
      (leading suffix : List (FieldName × Slot)) (name : FieldName) (old new : Slot) :
      Updated ⟨before ++ (parent, ⟨className, leading ++ (name, old) :: suffix⟩) :: after,
          variables, nextId⟩ (.field parent name) new
        ⟨before ++ (parent, ⟨className, leading ++ (name, new) :: suffix⟩) :: after,
          variables, nextId⟩

def References (state : State) : List ObjectId :=
  state.variables.filterMap (fun binding => binding.2) ++
    state.objects.flatMap (fun entry => entry.2.fields.filterMap (fun field => field.2))

def Allocated (state : State) (object : ObjectId) : Prop :=
  object ∈ state.objects.map Prod.fst

-- Liveness follows owners from a variable, then through initialized fields.
inductive Live (state : State) : ObjectId → Prop where
  | variable {name object} : (name, some object) ∈ state.variables → Live state object
  | field {parent object data name} :
      Live state parent → (parent, data) ∈ state.objects →
      (name, some object) ∈ data.fields → Live state object

structure Configuration where
  state : State
  code : List Statement
  deriving Repr

def Configuration.initial (program : Program) : Configuration :=
  ⟨State.empty, program.body⟩

def Configuration.finished (configuration : Configuration) : Prop :=
  configuration.code = []

end Dada.Unique

import Unique.State

namespace Dada.Unique

-- Resolving a place reads the graph without changing any slot.
inductive Resolve (state : State) : Place → StoragePlace → ObjectId → Prop where
  | variable {name object} :
      (name, some object) ∈ state.variables →
      Resolve state (.variable name) (.variable name) object
  | field {base source parent data name object} :
      Resolve state base source parent →
      (parent, data) ∈ state.objects →
      (name, some object) ∈ data.fields →
      Resolve state (.field base name) (.field parent name) object

-- Removing an owner leaves precisely that allocated slot uninitialized.
-- The list decompositions specify exact effects even on arbitrary raw states.
inductive Take : State → StoragePlace → ObjectId → State → Prop where
  | variable (objects : List (ObjectId × Object)) (nextId : Nat)
      (leading suffix : List (VariableId × Slot)) (name : VariableId) (object : ObjectId) :
      Take ⟨objects, leading ++ (name, some object) :: suffix, nextId⟩
        (.variable name) object
        ⟨objects, leading ++ (name, none) :: suffix, nextId⟩
  | field (variables : List (VariableId × Slot)) (nextId : Nat)
      (before after : List (ObjectId × Object)) (parent : ObjectId) (className : ClassName)
      (leading suffix : List (FieldName × Slot)) (name : FieldName) (object : ObjectId) :
      Take ⟨before ++ (parent, ⟨className, leading ++ (name, some object) :: suffix⟩) :: after,
          variables, nextId⟩
        (.field parent name) object
        ⟨before ++ (parent, ⟨className, leading ++ (name, none) :: suffix⟩) :: after,
          variables, nextId⟩

def State.bind (state : State) (name : VariableId) (object : ObjectId) : State :=
  { state with variables := (name, some object) :: state.variables }

def State.allocate (state : State) (className : ClassName) (fields : List FieldName)
    (arguments : List ObjectId) : State :=
  ⟨(⟨state.nextId⟩, ⟨className, fields.zip (arguments.map some)⟩) :: state.objects,
    state.variables, state.nextId + 1⟩

-- Results are held by the surrounding expression until construction or binding.
-- No invariant is a premise of evaluation; preservation is proved separately.
mutual
inductive Eval (classes : Classes) : State → Value → State → ObjectId → Prop where
  | give {state cleared : State} {path : Place} {source : StoragePlace} {object : ObjectId} :
      Resolve state path source object →
      Take state source object cleared →
      Eval classes state (.give path) cleared object
  | new {state evaluated : State} {className : ClassName} {declaration : Class}
      {arguments : List Value} {objects : List ObjectId} :
      (className, declaration) ∈ classes →
      EvalArgs classes state arguments evaluated objects →
      objects.length = declaration.fields.length →
      ObjectId.mk evaluated.nextId ∉ evaluated.objects.map Prod.fst →
      Eval classes state (.new className arguments)
        (evaluated.allocate className declaration.fields objects) ⟨evaluated.nextId⟩

inductive EvalArgs (classes : Classes) : State → List Value → State → List ObjectId → Prop where
  | nil (state : State) : EvalArgs classes state [] state []
  | cons {before middle after : State} {argument : Value} {arguments : List Value}
      {object : ObjectId} {objects : List ObjectId} :
      Eval classes before argument middle object →
      EvalArgs classes middle arguments after objects →
      EvalArgs classes before (argument :: arguments) after (object :: objects)
end

inductive Step (classes : Classes) : Configuration → Configuration → Prop where
  | letValue {state evaluated : State} {destination : VariableId} {value : Value}
      {object : ObjectId} {rest : List Statement} :
      destination ∉ evaluated.variables.map Prod.fst →
      Eval classes state value evaluated object →
      Step classes ⟨state, ⟨destination, value⟩ :: rest⟩
        ⟨evaluated.bind destination object, rest⟩

inductive Steps (classes : Classes) : Configuration → Configuration → Prop where
  | refl (configuration : Configuration) : Steps classes configuration configuration
  | step {before middle after} :
      Step classes before middle → Steps classes middle after → Steps classes before after

def Stuck (classes : Classes) (configuration : Configuration) : Prop :=
  ¬ configuration.finished ∧ ¬ ∃ after, Step classes configuration after

end Dada.Unique

-- Empty slots remain allocated; absence is a separate outer Option at lookup.
abbrev SlotDescription := Option ViewType
abbrev Environment := List (VariableId × SlotDescription)

def Admissible (classes : ClassTable) (ty : ViewType) : Prop :=
  ty.WellFormed classes ∧ Normalized classes ty

instance (classes : ClassTable) (ty : ViewType) : Decidable (Admissible classes ty) := by
  unfold Admissible Normalized
  infer_instance

def Environment.WellFormed (environment : Environment) (classes : ClassTable) : Prop :=
  (environment.map Prod.fst).Nodup ∧
    environment.all (fun entry => match entry.2 with
      | none => true
      | some ty => decide (Admissible classes ty)) = true

instance (environment : Environment) (classes : ClassTable) :
    Decidable (environment.WellFormed classes) := by
  unfold Environment.WellFormed
  infer_instance

def Environment.lookup (environment : Environment) (name : VariableId) :
    Option SlotDescription :=
  (environment.find? fun entry => entry.1 == name).map Prod.snd

def Environment.replace (environment : Environment) (name : VariableId)
    (description : SlotDescription) : Environment :=
  environment.map fun entry => if entry.1 = name then (name, description) else entry

def splitPlace : Place → VariableId × Path
  | .variable name => (name, [])
  | .field base name =>
      let (root, path) := splitPlace base
      (root, path ++ [name])

def placeFrom (root : VariableId) (path : Path) : Place :=
  path.foldl Place.field (.variable root)

theorem placeFrom_splitPlace (place : Place) :
    placeFrom (splitPlace place).1 (splitPlace place).2 = place := by
  induction place with
  | «variable» name => rfl
  | field base name ih =>
    simpa [splitPlace, placeFrom, List.foldl_append] using
      congrArg (fun p => Place.field p name) ih

-- Taking is a static operation: it never consults the heap or evaluation.
def take (classes : ClassTable) (environment : Environment) (place : Place) :
    Option (ViewType × Environment) := do
  let (root, path) := splitPlace place
  let source ← environment.lookup root
  let source ← source
  let result ← focus classes source path
  if path = [] then
    return (result, environment.replace root none)
  else
    let remaining ← emptyPath classes source path
    return (result, environment.replace root (some remaining))

def fieldDescription (classes : ClassTable) (ty : ViewType) (name : FieldName) :
    Option SlotDescription :=
  if negative ty [name] then some none
  else (focus classes ty [name]).map some

-- The well-formedness premises make the chapter's global convention explicit.
-- They inspect only finite static descriptions, not operational success.
mutual
inductive ExprTyped (classes : ClassTable) : Environment → Value → ViewType → Environment → Prop where
  | give {before after : Environment} {place : Place} {ty : ViewType} :
      before.WellFormed classes →
      take classes before place = some (ty, after) →
      Admissible classes ty → after.WellFormed classes →
      ExprTyped classes before (.give place) ty after
  | new {before after : Environment} {name : ClassName} {declaration : TypedClass}
      {arguments : List Value} :
      (name, declaration) ∈ classes →
      ArgsTyped classes before arguments (declaration.fields.map Prod.snd) after →
      Admissible classes (ViewType.whole name) →
      ExprTyped classes before (.new name arguments) (ViewType.whole name) after
  | weaken {before after : Environment} {value : Value} {ty other : ViewType} :
      ExprTyped classes before value ty after →
      Admissible classes other → Subtype classes ty other →
      ExprTyped classes before value other after

inductive ArgsTyped (classes : ClassTable) : Environment → List Value → List ClassName → Environment → Prop where
  | nil {environment : Environment} :
      environment.WellFormed classes → ArgsTyped classes environment [] [] environment
  | cons {before middle after : Environment} {value : Value} {values : List Value}
      {name : ClassName} {names : List ClassName} :
      ExprTyped classes before value (ViewType.whole name) middle →
      ArgsTyped classes middle values names after →
      ArgsTyped classes before (value :: values) (name :: names) after
end

-- Pattern order determines binding order; all field names must still be present.
inductive FieldBindings (classes : ClassTable) (ty : ViewType) : List (FieldName × VariableId) → Environment → Prop where
  | nil : FieldBindings classes ty [] []
  | cons {field : FieldName} {destination : VariableId} {description : SlotDescription}
      {fields : List (FieldName × VariableId)} {bindings : Environment} :
      fieldDescription classes ty field = some description →
      FieldBindings classes ty fields bindings →
      FieldBindings classes ty ((field, destination) :: fields)
        ((destination, description) :: bindings)

inductive BindingTyped (classes : ClassTable) : Environment → Unpacking.Pattern → ViewType → Environment → Prop where
  | variable {environment : Environment} {name : VariableId} {ty : ViewType} :
      environment.WellFormed classes → Admissible classes ty →
      name ∉ environment.map Prod.fst →
      BindingTyped classes environment (.variable name) ty ((name, some ty) :: environment)
  | unpack {before : Environment} {ty : ViewType} {name : ClassName}
      {declaration : TypedClass} {fields : List (FieldName × VariableId)}
      {bindings : Environment} :
      before.WellFormed classes → Admissible classes ty →
      ty.className = name → (name, declaration) ∈ classes →
      (fields.map Prod.fst).Perm (declaration.fields.map Prod.fst) →
      (fields.map Prod.snd).Nodup →
      (∀ destination ∈ fields.map Prod.snd, destination ∉ before.map Prod.fst) →
      FieldBindings classes ty fields bindings →
      (bindings ++ before).WellFormed classes →
      BindingTyped classes before (.unpack name fields) ty (bindings ++ before)

inductive StatementTyped (classes : ClassTable) : Environment → Unpacking.Statement → Environment → Prop where
  | letValue {before middle after : Environment} {pattern : Unpacking.Pattern}
      {value : Value} {ty : ViewType} :
      ExprTyped classes before value ty middle →
      BindingTyped classes middle pattern ty after →
      StatementTyped classes before ⟨pattern, value⟩ after

inductive SequenceTyped (classes : ClassTable) : Environment → List Unpacking.Statement → Environment → Prop where
  | nil {environment : Environment} :
      environment.WellFormed classes → SequenceTyped classes environment [] environment
  | cons {before middle after : Environment} {statement : Unpacking.Statement}
      {rest : List Unpacking.Statement} :
      StatementTyped classes before statement middle →
      SequenceTyped classes middle rest after →
      SequenceTyped classes before (statement :: rest) after

def ProgramTyped (classes : ClassTable) (code : List Unpacking.Statement) : Prop :=
  classes.WellFormed ∧ ∃ finalEnvironment, SequenceTyped classes [] code finalEnvironment

theorem ArgsTyped.length (typed : ArgsTyped classes before values names after) :
    values.length = names.length := by
  induction typed using ArgsTyped.rec (motive_1 := fun _ _ _ _ _ => True) with
  | give => trivial
  | new => trivial
  | weaken => trivial
  | nil => rfl
  | cons _ _ _ rest => simpa using rest

theorem FieldBindings.keys (typed : FieldBindings classes ty fields bindings) :
    bindings.map Prod.fst = fields.map Prod.snd := by
  induction typed with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons _ _ ih => simp [ih]

-- Weakening cannot disguise an unsuccessful take as a typed give.
theorem ExprTyped.give_requires_take
    (typed : ExprTyped classes before value ty after) :
    ∀ place, value = .give place → ∃ result, take classes before place = some (result, after) := by
  induction typed using ExprTyped.rec (motive_2 := fun _ _ _ _ _ => True) with
  | give _ taken _ _ =>
    intro place equality
    cases equality
    exact ⟨_, taken⟩
  | new => intro place equality; cases equality
  | weaken _ _ _ ih => exact ih
  | nil => trivial
  | cons => trivial

theorem failed_take_not_typed (failed : take classes environment place = none) :
    ¬ ExprTyped classes environment (.give place) ty after := by
  intro typed
  obtain ⟨result, succeeded⟩ := typed.give_requires_take place rfl
  rw [failed] at succeeded
  contradiction

end Dada.Unique.Typing

theorem ClassTable.WellFormed.erase {classes : ClassTable} (wf : classes.WellFormed) :
    ClassesWellFormed classes.erase := by
  constructor
  · simpa [ClassTable.erase, List.map_map, Function.comp_def] using wf.1
  · intro name declaration member
    obtain ⟨⟨originalName, original⟩, present, equality⟩ := List.mem_map.mp member
    cases equality
    exact (wf.2 _ present).1

-- A move updates an existing slot's description; it never allocates a name.
theorem Environment.replace_keys (environment : Environment) (name : VariableId)
    (description : SlotDescription) :
    (environment.replace name description).map Prod.fst = environment.map Prod.fst := by
  simp only [Environment.replace, List.map_map]
  apply List.map_congr_left
  intro entry _
  by_cases same : entry.1 = name <;> simp [same]

theorem take_keys (taken : take classes before place = some (ty, after)) :
    after.map Prod.fst = before.map Prod.fst := by
  unfold take at taken
  obtain ⟨sourceSlot, _, taken⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp taken
  obtain ⟨source, _, taken⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp taken
  obtain ⟨result, _, taken⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp taken
  by_cases empty : (splitPlace place).2 = []
  · simp [empty] at taken
    rcases taken with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    exact Environment.replace_keys _ _ _
  · simp only [empty, ↓reduceIte] at taken
    obtain ⟨remaining, _, taken⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp taken
    simp only [pure, Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at taken
    rcases taken with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    exact Environment.replace_keys _ _ _

theorem ExprTyped.keys (typed : ExprTyped classes before value ty after) :
    after.map Prod.fst = before.map Prod.fst := by
  induction typed using ExprTyped.rec
    (motive_2 := fun before _ _ after _ => after.map Prod.fst = before.map Prod.fst) with
  | give _ taken _ _ => exact take_keys taken
  | new _ _ _ ih => exact ih
  | weaken _ _ _ ih => exact ih
  | nil => rfl
  | cons _ _ first rest => exact rest.trans first

theorem ArgsTyped.keys (typed : ArgsTyped classes before values names after) :
    after.map Prod.fst = before.map Prod.fst := by
  induction typed using ArgsTyped.rec (motive_1 := fun _ _ _ _ _ => True) with
  | give => trivial
  | new => trivial
  | weaken => trivial
  | nil => rfl
  | cons first _ _ rest => exact rest.trans first.keys

theorem ExprTyped.wellFormed (typed : ExprTyped classes before value ty after) :
    before.WellFormed classes ∧ Admissible classes ty ∧ after.WellFormed classes := by
  induction typed using ExprTyped.rec
    (motive_2 := fun before _ _ after _ =>
      before.WellFormed classes ∧ after.WellFormed classes) with
  | give beforeWf _ admissible afterWf => exact ⟨beforeWf, admissible, afterWf⟩
  | new _ _ admissible ih => exact ⟨ih.1, admissible, ih.2⟩
  | weaken _ admissible _ ih => exact ⟨ih.1, admissible, ih.2.2⟩
  | nil wf => exact ⟨wf, wf⟩
  | cons _ _ first rest => exact ⟨first.1, rest.2⟩

theorem ArgsTyped.wellFormed (typed : ArgsTyped classes before values names after) :
    before.WellFormed classes ∧ after.WellFormed classes := by
  induction typed using ArgsTyped.rec (motive_1 := fun _ _ _ _ _ => True) with
  | give => trivial
  | new => trivial
  | weaken => trivial
  | nil wf => exact ⟨wf, wf⟩
  | cons first _ _ rest => exact ⟨first.wellFormed.1, rest.2⟩

theorem BindingTyped.wellFormed (typed : BindingTyped classes before pattern ty after) :
    before.WellFormed classes ∧ Admissible classes ty ∧ after.WellFormed classes := by
  cases typed with
  | «variable» beforeWf admissible fresh =>
    refine ⟨beforeWf, admissible, ?_⟩
    simpa [Environment.WellFormed, admissible, fresh] using beforeWf
  | unpack beforeWf admissible _ _ _ _ _ _ afterWf =>
    exact ⟨beforeWf, admissible, afterWf⟩

theorem StatementTyped.wellFormed (typed : StatementTyped classes before statement after) :
    before.WellFormed classes ∧ after.WellFormed classes := by
  cases typed with
  | letValue expression binding => exact ⟨expression.wellFormed.1, binding.wellFormed.2.2⟩

theorem SequenceTyped.wellFormed (typed : SequenceTyped classes before statements after) :
    before.WellFormed classes ∧ after.WellFormed classes := by
  induction typed with
  | nil wf => exact ⟨wf, wf⟩
  | cons first _ rest => exact ⟨first.wellFormed.1, rest.2⟩

end Dada.Unique.Typing

-- An outer none means failed lookup. A final empty slot is some none.
-- Only a nonempty remaining path requires the selected slot to hold an object.
def readPath (state : State) (object : ObjectId) : Path → Option Slot
  | [] => do
      let _ ← state.objects.lookup object
      return some object
  | field :: rest => do
      let data ← state.objects.lookup object
      let slot ← data.fields.lookup field
      match rest with
      | [] => return slot
      | _ :: _ => do
          let target ← slot
          readPath state target rest

-- Views constrain known paths, while unlisted paths impose no local condition.
-- Positive paths require allocated objects of the declared nominal class.
structure Satisfies (classes : ClassTable) (state : State) (object : ObjectId) (ty : ViewType) : Prop where
  root : ∃ data, (object, data) ∈ state.objects ∧ data.className = ty.className
  positive : ∀ path, Pos classes ty path →
    ∃ target data, readPath state object path = some (some target) ∧
      (target, data) ∈ state.objects ∧
      classAt classes ty.className path = some data.className
  negative : ∀ path, Neg ty path → readPath state object path = some none

-- This nominal condition includes occupied fields hidden by a view.
def FieldsMatchClasses (classes : ClassTable) (state : State) : Prop :=
  ∀ parent data field target, (parent, data) ∈ state.objects →
    (field, some target) ∈ data.fields →
    ∃ declaration targetClass targetData,
      (data.className, declaration) ∈ classes ∧
      (field, targetClass) ∈ declaration.fields ∧
      (target, targetData) ∈ state.objects ∧ targetData.className = targetClass

abbrev PendingValues := List (ObjectId × ViewType)

-- Exact domain equality is extensional: list order does not affect realization.
-- Hidden owners and pending expression results remain in ownership accounting.
structure Realizes (classes : ClassTable) (environment : Environment) (state : State) (pending : PendingValues) : Prop where
  classesWellFormed : classes.WellFormed
  environmentWellFormed : environment.WellFormed classes
  pendingTypes : ∀ object ty, (object, ty) ∈ pending → Admissible classes ty
  ownership : WellFormedWith classes.erase state (pending.map Prod.fst)
  fields : FieldsMatchClasses classes state
  variableDomain : ∀ name,
    name ∈ environment.map Prod.fst ↔ name ∈ state.variables.map Prod.fst
  emptyVariables : ∀ name, (name, none) ∈ environment → (name, none) ∈ state.variables
  initializedVariables : ∀ name ty, (name, some ty) ∈ environment →
    ∃ object, (name, some object) ∈ state.variables ∧ Satisfies classes state object ty
  pendingValues : ∀ object ty, (object, ty) ∈ pending → Satisfies classes state object ty

theorem readPath_nil (state : State) (object : ObjectId) :
    readPath state object [] = (state.objects.lookup object).map (fun _ => some object) := by
  cases found : state.objects.lookup object <;> simp [readPath, found]

theorem readPath_singleton (state : State) (object : ObjectId) (field : FieldName) :
    readPath state object [field] =
      (state.objects.lookup object).bind (fun data => data.fields.lookup field) := by
  simp [readPath]

theorem readPath_empty (object : ObjectId) (path : Path) :
    readPath State.empty object path = none := by
  cases path <;> simp [readPath, State.empty]

theorem Satisfies.weaken (satisfied : Satisfies classes state object source)
    (sourceNormal : Normalized classes source) (targetNormal : Normalized classes target)
    (subtype : Subtype classes source target) : Satisfies classes state object target := by
  obtain ⟨sameClass, positives, negatives⟩ := subtype
  unfold Normalized at sourceNormal targetNormal
  rw [sourceNormal, targetNormal] at positives negatives
  constructor
  · obtain ⟨data, stored, correctClass⟩ := satisfied.root
    exact ⟨data, stored, correctClass.trans sameClass⟩
  · intro path positive
    obtain ⟨result, data, read, stored, correctClass⟩ :=
      satisfied.positive path (positives path positive)
    exact ⟨result, data, read, stored, sameClass ▸ correctClass⟩
  · intro path negative
    exact satisfied.negative path (negatives path negative)

theorem Realizes.empty {classes : ClassTable} (classesWellFormed : classes.WellFormed) :
    Realizes classes [] State.empty [] := by
  constructor
  · exact classesWellFormed
  · simp [Environment.WellFormed]
  · simp
  · exact (WellFormed.empty classes.erase).with_empty
  · simp [FieldsMatchClasses, State.empty]
  · simp [State.empty]
  · simp
  · simp
  · simp

namespace Dada.Unique.Unpacking

-- Patterns consume an expression result; they are not value expressions.
inductive Pattern where
  | variable (name : VariableId)
  | unpack (className : ClassName) (fields : List (FieldName × VariableId))
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def Pattern.variables : Pattern → List VariableId
  | .variable name => [name]
  | .unpack _ fields => fields.map Prod.snd

structure Statement where
  pattern : Pattern
  value : Value
  deriving Repr

structure Configuration where
  state : State
  code : List Statement
  deriving Repr

def Configuration.finished (configuration : Configuration) : Prop :=
  configuration.code = []

-- Choose each named field exactly once, in pattern order. Empty slots are
-- transferred too. The empty case requires that no field was left behind.
inductive Transfer : List (FieldName × VariableId) → List (FieldName × Slot) → List (VariableId × Slot) → Prop where
  | nil : Transfer [] [] []
  | cons {field name slot pattern before after bindings} :
      Transfer pattern (before ++ after) bindings →
      Transfer ((field, name) :: pattern) (before ++ (field, slot) :: after)
        ((name, slot) :: bindings)

-- Binding itself neither evaluates an expression nor assumes an invariant.
inductive Bind (classes : Classes) : State → ObjectId → Pattern → State → Prop where
  | variable {state object name} :
      name ∉ state.variables.map Prod.fst →
      Bind classes state object (.variable name) (state.bind name object)
  | unpack {before after variables nextId object className fields pattern bindings declaration} :
      (className, declaration) ∈ classes →
      fields.map Prod.fst = declaration.fields →
      (pattern.map Prod.fst).Nodup →
      (pattern.map Prod.snd).Nodup →
      (∀ name ∈ pattern.map Prod.snd, name ∉ variables.map Prod.fst) →
      Transfer pattern fields bindings →
      Bind classes ⟨before ++ (object, ⟨className, fields⟩) :: after, variables, nextId⟩
        object (.unpack className pattern)
        ⟨before ++ after, bindings ++ variables, nextId⟩

inductive Step (classes : Classes) : Configuration → Configuration → Prop where
  | letValue {before evaluated after pattern value object rest} :
      Eval classes before value evaluated object →
      Bind classes evaluated object pattern after →
      Step classes ⟨before, ⟨pattern, value⟩ :: rest⟩ ⟨after, rest⟩

inductive Steps (classes : Classes) : Configuration → Configuration → Prop where
  | refl (configuration : Configuration) : Steps classes configuration configuration
  | step {before middle after} :
      Step classes before middle → Steps classes middle after → Steps classes before after

def Stuck (classes : Classes) (configuration : Configuration) : Prop :=
  ¬ configuration.finished ∧ ¬ ∃ after, Step classes configuration after

theorem Bind.fresh (binding : Bind classes before object pattern after) :
    ∀ name ∈ pattern.variables, name ∉ before.variables.map Prod.fst := by
  cases binding with
  | «variable» fresh => simpa [Pattern.variables] using fresh
  | unpack _ _ _ _ fresh _ => exact fresh

theorem Transfer.keys (transfer : Transfer pattern fields bindings) :
    bindings.map Prod.fst = pattern.map Prod.snd := by
  induction transfer with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons _ ih => simp [ih]

theorem Transfer.slots (transfer : Transfer pattern fields bindings) :
    (bindings.map Prod.snd).Perm (fields.map Prod.snd) := by
  induction transfer with
  | nil => exact .refl _
  | @cons field name slot pattern before after bindings _ ih =>
    simp only [List.map_append] at ih
    simpa using (List.Perm.cons slot ih).trans
      (List.perm_middle (a := slot) (l₁ := before.map Prod.snd)
        (l₂ := after.map Prod.snd)).symm

theorem Transfer.field_keys (transfer : Transfer pattern fields bindings) :
    (pattern.map Prod.fst).Perm (fields.map Prod.fst) := by
  induction transfer with
  | nil => exact .refl _
  | @cons field name slot pattern before after bindings _ ih =>
    simp only [List.map_append] at ih
    simpa using (List.Perm.cons field ih).trans
      (List.perm_middle (a := field) (l₁ := before.map Prod.fst)
        (l₂ := after.map Prod.fst)).symm

private abbrev slotReferences {K : Type} (slots : List (K × Slot)) : List ObjectId :=
  slots.filterMap (fun entry => entry.2)

theorem Transfer.references (transfer : Transfer pattern fields bindings) :
    (slotReferences bindings).Perm (slotReferences fields) := by
  simpa [slotReferences, List.filterMap_map, Function.comp_def] using
    transfer.slots.filterMap id

-- Relocating the fields changes where their references occur, not which
-- references remain. The consumed container is the separate pending root.
private theorem unpack_references
    (transfer : Transfer pattern fields bindings)
    (before after : List (ObjectId × Object)) (variables : List (VariableId × Slot))
    (nextId : Nat) (object : ObjectId) (className : ClassName) :
    (References ⟨before ++ (object, ⟨className, fields⟩) :: after, variables, nextId⟩).Perm
      (References ⟨before ++ after, bindings ++ variables, nextId⟩) := by
  apply List.perm_iff_count.mpr
  intro id
  have same := transfer.references.count_eq id
  simp only [References, List.filterMap_append, List.flatMap_append, List.flatMap_cons,
    List.count_append] at *
  change List.count id (slotReferences variables) +
      (List.count id (before.flatMap fun e => slotReferences e.2.fields) +
        (List.count id (slotReferences fields) +
          List.count id (after.flatMap fun e => slotReferences e.2.fields))) =
    (List.count id (slotReferences bindings) + List.count id (slotReferences variables)) +
      (List.count id (before.flatMap fun e => slotReferences e.2.fields) +
        List.count id (after.flatMap fun e => slotReferences e.2.fields))
  omega

theorem Bind.preserves_wellFormed
    (binding : Bind classes before object pattern after)
    (wf : WellFormedWith classes before [object]) : WellFormed classes after := by
  cases binding with
  | «variable» fresh => exact wf.bind fresh
  | @unpack before after variables nextId object className fields pattern bindings declaration
      declared shape uniqueFields uniqueNames fresh transfer =>
    have subset : ∀ entry ∈ before ++ after,
        entry ∈ before ++ (object, ⟨className, fields⟩) :: after := by
      intro entry member
      rcases List.mem_append.mp member with left | right
      · exact List.mem_append_left _ left
      · exact List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ right)
    have keys : (before.map Prod.fst ++ object :: after.map Prod.fst).Nodup := by
      simpa using wf.objectKeys
    have removedKeys : (before.map Prod.fst ++ after.map Prod.fst).Nodup :=
      List.Nodup.sublist
        ((List.Sublist.refl _).append (List.sublist_cons_self _ _)) keys
    have removedAbsent : object ∉ before.map Prod.fst ++ after.map Prod.fst := by
      have perm := List.perm_middle (a := object) (l₁ := before.map Prod.fst)
        (l₂ := after.map Prod.fst)
      exact (List.nodup_cons.mp (perm.nodup_iff.mp keys)).1
    have refs := unpack_references transfer before after variables nextId object className
    have uniqueAfter : (object :: References
        ⟨before ++ after, bindings ++ variables, nextId⟩).Nodup := by
      exact (List.Perm.cons object refs).nodup_iff.mp wf.referencesUnique
    constructor
    · simpa using removedKeys
    · simp only [List.map_append, transfer.keys]
      apply List.nodup_append.mpr
      refine ⟨uniqueNames, wf.variableKeys, ?_⟩
      intro name member other otherMember equality
      subst other
      exact fresh name member otherMember
    · intro id data member
      exact wf.shapes id data (subset _ member)
    · intro id data member
      exact wf.bounds id data (subset _ member)
    · intro id data name target member field
      exact wf.older id data name target (subset _ member) field
    · exact (List.nodup_cons.mp uniqueAfter).2
    · intro id
      have complete := wf.referencesComplete id
      simp only [List.singleton_append, List.mem_cons, Allocated, List.map_append,
        List.map_cons, List.mem_append] at complete
      change id ∈ References ⟨before ++ after, bindings ++ variables, nextId⟩ ↔
        id ∈ (before ++ after).map Prod.fst
      by_cases same : id = object
      · subst id
        have noRef := (List.nodup_cons.mp uniqueAfter).1
        simp [noRef, List.map_append, removedAbsent]
      · rw [← refs.mem_iff]
        simpa [same, List.map_append] using complete

theorem Step.preserves_wellFormed (classesWf : ClassesWellFormed classes)
    (wf : WellFormed classes before.state) (step : Step classes before after) :
    WellFormed classes after.state := by
  cases step with
  | letValue evaluation binding =>
    exact binding.preserves_wellFormed
      (evaluation.preserves_pending classesWf [] wf.with_empty)

theorem Steps.preserves_wellFormed (classesWf : ClassesWellFormed classes)
    (wf : WellFormed classes before.state) (steps : Steps classes before after) :
    WellFormed classes after.state := by
  induction steps with
  | refl => exact wf
  | step first _ ih => exact ih (first.preserves_wellFormed classesWf wf)

def embedStatement (statement : Dada.Unique.Statement) : Statement :=
  ⟨.variable statement.destination, statement.value⟩

def embedConfiguration (configuration : Dada.Unique.Configuration) : Configuration :=
  ⟨configuration.state, configuration.code.map embedStatement⟩

theorem embed_step (step : Dada.Unique.Step classes before after) :
    Step classes (embedConfiguration before) (embedConfiguration after) := by
  cases step with
  | letValue fresh evaluation => exact .letValue evaluation (.variable fresh)

-- There is no new transition available to a program containing only the old
-- variable patterns, even when the successor is not assumed to be embedded.
theorem reflect_step (step : Step classes (embedConfiguration before) after) :
    ∃ next, Dada.Unique.Step classes before next ∧ after = embedConfiguration next := by
  rcases before with ⟨state, code⟩
  cases code with
  | nil => cases step
  | cons statement rest =>
    rcases statement with ⟨destination, value⟩
    cases step with
    | letValue evaluation binding =>
      cases binding with
      | «variable» fresh => exact ⟨_, .letValue fresh evaluation, rfl⟩

theorem embed_steps (steps : Dada.Unique.Steps classes before after) :
    Steps classes (embedConfiguration before) (embedConfiguration after) := by
  induction steps with
  | refl => exact .refl _
  | step first _ ih => exact .step (embed_step first) ih

theorem embed_finished : (embedConfiguration configuration).finished ↔ configuration.finished := by
  simp [embedConfiguration, Configuration.finished, Dada.Unique.Configuration.finished]

theorem Step.code_length (step : Step classes before after) :
    before.code.length = after.code.length + 1 := by
  cases step
  rfl

end Dada.Unique.Unpacking

  · decide

    ⟨(2, partialPair) :: tokenObjects, [("p", some 2)], 3⟩ 0 := by

  · apply Resolve.field (parent := 2) (data := pairObject)
    · exact Resolve.variable (by decide)
    · decide
    · decide
  · exact Take.field [("p", some 2)] 3 [] tokenObjects 2 "Pair" []
      [("right", some 1)] "left" 0

    (Take.variable ((2, partialPair) :: tokenObjects) 3 [("taken", some 0)] [] "p" 2)

  · simp [exampleClasses]

  · exact Transfer.cons (before := []) (Transfer.cons (before := []) .nil)

  apply Steps.step (middle := ⟨constructed, unpackingProgram.tail⟩)
  · exact Step.letValue construct_pair (.variable (by decide))
  · apply Steps.step (middle := ⟨movedLeft, unpackingProgram.tail.tail⟩)
    · exact Step.letValue move_left (.variable (by decide))
    · exact .step (.letValue take_pair unpack_pair) (.refl _)

namespace Dada.Unique.Typing

structure TypedClass where
  fields : List (FieldName × ClassName)
  deriving DecidableEq, BEq, ReflBEq, LawfulBEq, Repr

abbrev ClassTable := List (ClassName × TypedClass)

def ClassTable.erase (classes : ClassTable) : Classes :=
  classes.map fun (name, declaration) => (name, ⟨declaration.fields.map Prod.fst⟩)

def ClassTable.WellFormed (classes : ClassTable) : Prop :=
  (classes.map Prod.fst).Nodup ∧
    ∀ entry ∈ classes, (entry.2.fields.map Prod.fst).Nodup ∧
      ∀ field ∈ entry.2.fields, field.2 ∈ classes.map Prod.fst

instance (classes : ClassTable) : Decidable classes.WellFormed := by
  unfold ClassTable.WellFormed
  infer_instance

abbrev Path := List FieldName

def classAt (classes : ClassTable) (base : ClassName) : Path → Option ClassName
  | [] => some base
  | field :: rest => do
      let declaration ← classes.lookup base
      let target ← declaration.fields.lookup field
      classAt classes target rest

inductive Entry where
  | positive (path : Path)
  | negative (path : Path)
  deriving DecidableEq, BEq, ReflBEq, LawfulBEq, Repr

def Entry.path : Entry → Path
  | .positive path | .negative path => path

def Entry.prepend (initialPath : Path) : Entry → Entry
  | .positive path => .positive (initialPath ++ path)
  | .negative path => .negative (initialPath ++ path)

def Entry.dropPrefix (initialPath : Path) (entry : Entry) : Option Entry :=
  if initialPath.isPrefixOf entry.path then
    some (match entry with
      | .positive path => .positive (path.drop initialPath.length)
      | .negative path => .negative (path.drop initialPath.length))
  else none

structure ViewType where
  className : ClassName
  entries : List Entry
  deriving DecidableEq, BEq, ReflBEq, LawfulBEq, Repr

def ViewType.whole (name : ClassName) : ViewType :=
  ⟨name, [.positive []]⟩

def Entry.valid (classes : ClassTable) (base : ClassName) (entry : Entry) : Bool :=
  (classAt classes base entry.path).isSome &&
    match entry with
    | .positive _ => true
    | .negative path => !path.isEmpty

def entriesDisjoint : List Entry → Bool
  | [] => true
  | entry :: rest =>
    rest.all (fun other =>
      !entry.path.isPrefixOf other.path && !other.path.isPrefixOf entry.path) &&
    entriesDisjoint rest

def ViewType.WellFormed (ty : ViewType) (classes : ClassTable) : Prop :=
  (classes.lookup ty.className).isSome = true ∧
    ty.entries.all (Entry.valid classes ty.className) = true ∧
    entriesDisjoint ty.entries = true

instance (ty : ViewType) (classes : ClassTable) : Decidable (ty.WellFormed classes) := by
  unfold ViewType.WellFormed
  infer_instance

def positive (classes : ClassTable) (ty : ViewType) (path : Path) : Bool :=
  (classAt classes ty.className path).isSome &&
    (path.isEmpty || ty.entries.any (fun entry =>
      (path.length < entry.path.length && path.isPrefixOf entry.path) ||
      match entry with
      | .positive initialPath => initialPath.isPrefixOf path
      | .negative _ => false))

def negative (ty : ViewType) (path : Path) : Bool :=
  ty.entries.contains (.negative path)

def Pos (classes : ClassTable) (ty : ViewType) (path : Path) : Prop :=
  positive classes ty path = true

def Neg (ty : ViewType) (path : Path) : Prop :=
  negative ty path = true

instance (classes : ClassTable) (ty : ViewType) (path : Path) :
    Decidable (Pos classes ty path) := inferInstanceAs (Decidable (positive classes ty path = true))

instance (ty : ViewType) (path : Path) :
    Decidable (Neg ty path) := inferInstanceAs (Decidable (negative ty path = true))

def Full (classes : ClassTable) (ty : ViewType) : Prop :=
  ∀ path, Pos classes ty path →
    ∀ name declaration, classAt classes ty.className path = some name →
      classes.lookup name = some declaration →
      ∀ field ∈ declaration.fields,
        Pos classes ty (path ++ [field.1]) ∨ Neg ty (path ++ [field.1])

-- A recursive call is made only for a field with an entry beneath it. An absent
-- field therefore remains unknown, including when its declared class is empty.
-- The depth bound comes from the finite input paths, not from class unfolding.
def normalizeEntries (classes : ClassTable) : Nat → ClassName → List Entry → List Entry
  | fuel, name, entries =>
    if entries.contains (.positive []) then [.positive []]
    else match classes.lookup name with
    | none => entries
    | some declaration =>
      if declaration.fields.isEmpty && entries.isEmpty then [.positive []]
      else match fuel with
      | 0 => entries
      | fuel + 1 =>
        let children := declaration.fields.flatMap fun (field, target) =>
          let selected := entries.filterMap (Entry.dropPrefix [field])
          if selected.isEmpty then []
          else if selected.contains (.negative []) then [.negative [field]]
          else (normalizeEntries classes fuel target selected).map (Entry.prepend [field])
        if !declaration.fields.isEmpty && declaration.fields.all
            (fun field => children.contains (.positive [field.1])) then
          [.positive []]
        else children

def normalize (classes : ClassTable) (ty : ViewType) : ViewType :=
  let depth := ty.entries.foldl (fun depth entry => max depth entry.path.length) 0
  { ty with entries := normalizeEntries classes (depth + 1) ty.className ty.entries }

def Normalized (classes : ClassTable) (ty : ViewType) : Prop :=
  normalize classes ty = ty

instance (classes : ClassTable) (ty : ViewType) : Decidable (Normalized classes ty) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (normalize classes ty = ty))

def focus (classes : ClassTable) (ty : ViewType) (path : Path) : Option ViewType := do
  if !decide (ty.WellFormed classes) then none else do
    let source := normalize classes ty
    if !positive classes source path then none else do
      let target ← classAt classes source.className path
      if path.isEmpty then some source
      else if source.entries.any (fun entry => match entry with
          | .positive initialPath => initialPath.isPrefixOf path
          | .negative _ => false) then
        some (.whole target)
      else some (normalize classes ⟨target, source.entries.filterMap (Entry.dropPrefix path)⟩)

-- Expand a whole subtree only along the path being taken. Its siblings retain
-- positive entries; the target itself is omitted and will receive one negative
-- entry in emptyPath. Recursion is on the finite target path.
def remainingAfterMove (classes : ClassTable) (name : ClassName) : Path → List Entry
  | [] => []
  | field :: rest =>
    match classes.lookup name with
    | none => []
    | some declaration => declaration.fields.flatMap fun (other, target) =>
        if other == field then
          (remainingAfterMove classes target rest).map (Entry.prepend [other])
        else [.positive [other]]

def emptyPath (classes : ClassTable) (ty : ViewType) (path : Path) : Option ViewType :=
  if !decide (ty.WellFormed classes) || path.isEmpty then none
  else
    let source := normalize classes ty
    if !positive classes source path then none
    else
      let retained := source.entries.flatMap fun entry =>
        if path.isPrefixOf entry.path then []
        else match entry with
        | .negative _ => [entry]
        | .positive initialPath =>
          if initialPath.isPrefixOf path then
            match classAt classes source.className initialPath with
            | none => []
            | some target =>
              (remainingAfterMove classes target (path.drop initialPath.length)).map
                (Entry.prepend initialPath)
          else [entry]
      some (normalize classes ⟨source.className, retained ++ [.negative path]⟩)

def Subtype (classes : ClassTable) (source target : ViewType) : Prop :=
  source.className = target.className ∧
    (∀ path, Pos classes (normalize classes target) path →
      Pos classes (normalize classes source) path) ∧
    (∀ path, Neg (normalize classes target) path → Neg (normalize classes source) path)

theorem normalize_className (classes : ClassTable) (ty : ViewType) :
    (normalize classes ty).className = ty.className := rfl

theorem normalize_whole (classes : ClassTable) (name : ClassName) :
    normalize classes (.whole name) = .whole name := by
  simp [normalize, normalizeEntries, ViewType.whole]

theorem Pos.root (classes : ClassTable) (ty : ViewType) : Pos classes ty [] := by
  rfl

theorem positive_whole (classes : ClassTable) (name : ClassName) (path : Path) :
    positive classes (.whole name) path = (classAt classes name path).isSome := by
  simp [positive, ViewType.whole, Entry.path]

theorem Pos.valid (known : Pos classes ty path) :
    (classAt classes ty.className path).isSome = true := by
  exact (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp known).1

theorem focus_root (wf : ty.WellFormed classes) :
    focus classes ty [] = some (normalize classes ty) := by
  simp [focus, wf, positive, classAt]

theorem emptyPath_root (classes : ClassTable) (ty : ViewType) :
    emptyPath classes ty [] = none := by
  simp [emptyPath]

theorem Subtype.refl (classes : ClassTable) (ty : ViewType) : Subtype classes ty ty :=
  ⟨rfl, fun _ h => h, fun _ h => h⟩

theorem Subtype.trans (first : Subtype classes source middle)
    (second : Subtype classes middle target) : Subtype classes source target :=
  ⟨first.1.trans second.1,
    fun path h => first.2.1 path (second.2.1 path h),
    fun path h => first.2.2 path (second.2.2 path h)⟩

theorem negative_whole (name : ClassName) (path : Path) :
    negative (.whole name) path = false := by
  rfl

end Dada.Unique.Typing
